description: This is a Java class defining a REST controller named UserController, which manages API endpoints for user-related operations in a banking system, such as registering, updating, and retrieving users.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller for managing user entities in the banking system, providing endpoints for creating, updating, and retrieving user information.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new user using provided User data.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update existing user data based on user ID.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of users.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a user by their ID.
